For the ‘what if’ and the ‘why not’.

Nativas is a small, friendly studio for making games and interactive scenes. Arrange objects in 2D or 3D, bring them to life with plain-English scripts, paint your own textures, and export a playable HTML project when you are ready to share.

    Keyframes control position, rotation, and scale. Set “Path to next” to Curve, then drag the blue square handles in the preview to shape the motion. You can also edit handle coordinates numerically. Drag diamonds to retime keys; scrub the ruler to inspect poses.     About Nativas
    Nativas v0.35.5
    A visual project editor with Integral scripting, 2D/3D objects, animation, textures, vector tools, and project export.
    Major features
    • 0.35.4 — New branded Studio homepage, working documentation/About entry points, and corrected editor launch sizing.
    • 0.35 — Editor font selection and custom font uploads; readable, background-aware syntax highlighting; fully collapsible editor/tool panels; refreshed Scene and 3D icons.
    • 0.34.20 — Custom code-rendering engine with a smoothed caret and selection layer, typing/deletion fades, and hidden Scratch-style block-mode controls.
    • 0.34.19 — Updated the animation icon for light and dark themes and refined the code-editor presentation.
    • 0.34.17 — Improved code-window syntax contrast; removed quick-add 2D shape buttons.
    • 0.34.16 — Cursor transform reset on state changes; project-editor theme previews.
    • 0.34.15 — Settings tabs, categorized theme explorer, dedicated code-window color, cursor/selection theme matching, gradient alternates.
    • 0.34.14 — Expanded, more saturated color themes.
    • 0.34.13 — Cursor/metaball refinements, dark-mode wordmark and selection styling, expanded themes, themed viewport controls.
    Minor fixes and maintenance updates are intentionally omitted.
